title: Ford's 2028 WRC return 'will help shape' next-gen rally-bred EVs
extract: Ford's planned return to the World Rally Championship from 2028 is being positioned as a development programme that will help shape future rally-inspired electric and hybrid road-car technology.

title: Priaulx, Rockenfeller share initial impressions on Ford Hypercar ahead of IMSA finale
extract: Sebastian Priaulx and Mike Rockenfeller have shared early impressions of Ford's new LMDh programme after its latest Silverstone test, describing a promising car-development effort.

title: Runway to close for international car event on Saturday
extract: Around 70 high-performance, classic and luxury cars are gathering for an international motoring event in Gibraltar, prompting a temporary closure of the territory's airport runway.

title: Google launches AI chips into orbit to test space data centers
extract: Google is testing whether AI computing could work in orbit by putting AI accelerators into space, examining radiation, cooling and the networking challenges a future space data centre would face.

title: The amazing work by Valve's Timur Kristóf on improving old AMD GPUs on Linux
extract: Valve graphics engineer Timur Kristóf has spent the past year improving the upstream AMDGPU driver for decade-old GCN graphics hardware, helping older cards gain better functionality and Linux gaming support.

title: Meta wants people to build their own Muse gadgets, too
extract: Meta is opening up more of the hardware and software surrounding its Muse AI gadget concept, pointing toward a platform where developers can build their own devices and experiences.

title: Maxell launches a new cassette tape in 2026, and your Commodore 64 can use it
extract: Maxell has released a new Type I ferric cassette in Japan, giving owners of cassette-based machines such as the Commodore 64 and ZX Spectrum a genuinely new piece of compatible storage media.

title: The story behind Windows XP's infamous FCKGW product key
extract: A look back at the notorious FCKGW Windows XP product key and the role it played in the software's early piracy and activation history.

title: Lemmings gets a new Amiga level editor 35 years after release
extract: A new editor lets Amiga owners create custom Lemmings levels more than three decades after the original game, extending the classic puzzle game's community tooling on original hardware.

title: Half-Life gets PS5 homebrew port with LAN multiplayer and DualSense
extract: The XashPS5 project brings the original Half-Life engine to PlayStation 5 with DualSense controls, local multiplayer and a 60fps target while requiring the user's own game data.

title: Real Racing 3 is running on PS Vita more than a decade after launch
extract: An unofficial project is running an early version of Electronic Arts' Real Racing 3 natively on PlayStation Vita, with adapted physical controls and playable races despite ongoing performance work.

title: David Bowie's 'lifetime' ban from venue lifted posthumously
extract: David Bowie is set to return to Brighton Dome through a 2027 immersive exhibition after a posthumous decision to lift a lifetime ban imposed after his Ziggy Stardust-era appearance there.

title: Glass's Symphonic Celebration of Bowie
extract: A Glasgow concert marking ten years since David Bowie's death paired Philip Glass's Heroes-based symphonic work with the Royal Scottish National Orchestra and digital visual art.

title: AC/DC concludes 2026 Power Up tour
extract: AC/DC has concluded its 2026 Power Up tour after the final performances, bringing the latest North American leg of the band's long-running comeback touring cycle to a close.

title: Middle Grade SFF for Young Readers — And the Young at Heart
extract: Reactor rounds up new middle-grade speculative fiction featuring dragons, robots and other imaginative concepts, highlighting several forthcoming science-fiction and fantasy titles.

title: Beyond the Brightening Sea by Trudy J. Morgan-Cole
extract: A review of Trudy J. Morgan-Cole's historical novel, set in seventeenth-century Newfoundland and focused on four women navigating a colonial world where power and survival are tightly constrained.

title: The Pirate Queen by Ariel Lawhon
extract: A review of Ariel Lawhon's historical novel about Grace O'Malley, the sixteenth-century Irish pirate queen, praised for turning a sparse historical record into an immersive character-driven story.

title: Tantalizing Tales — October 2026 — Part One
extract: The first October roundup highlights new fiction including A.E. Goldin's Death on the Pearl River, a historical mystery set in 1856 Hong Kong amid political unrest, crime and the opium trade.

title: Jillian Miller Interview: “I fell in love with historical fiction as a kid”
extract: Historical-fiction author Jillian Miller discusses her writing, research and long-standing fascination with reconstructing past worlds and the lives of people within them.

title: Star Trek Movie Reboot Details Reveal a Very Different Approach
extract: New details about the next Star Trek movie indicate a different approach for the franchise, with John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein attached to write and direct.

title: Star Trek Creator's Forgotten TV Show Premiered 26 Years Ago
extract: A retrospective revisits The Lieutenant, an early television series created by Gene Roddenberry before Star Trek, and examines its place in his wider television career.

title: Netflix Renews A Different World
extract: Netflix has renewed its A Different World sequel series for a second season after the first ten-episode run reached the streamer's global top ten.

title: From Below to Tyler Perry's Doing Life: What to Watch on Netflix
extract: Netflix's October 2 roundup highlights new film and TV arrivals including the sea-creature thriller Below, a Michael Schumacher documentary built around archival footage, and several comedy and drama additions.

title: What To Watch Saturday: Dakota Johnson Hosts SNL, Supergirl Vet's Hallmark Movie, And More
extract: TVLine's October 3 viewing guide rounds up new and returning television for Saturday, including Dakota Johnson hosting Saturday Night Live and a new Hallmark film.

title: Champions (aka Young Avengers)
extract: Production List reports that Marvel Studios' Champions, also known as Young Avengers, is in production and casting, with a younger group of MCU heroes at its centre.
